'''Panther Two''' was the callsign used by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] when flying a [[YT-5100 Shriek-class bomber|YT-5100 ''Shriek''-class bomber]] during the [[Battle of Tralus (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tralus]]. As Panther Two, he was one half of [[Panther Flight]]; [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] flew lead as [[Panther One]].
